description: Sullivan County Visitors Association grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples in 100 Sullivan Ave., NY. The farm is small, and its seasons run through spring, summer, and autumn. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Apr – Jun in this growing zone.
